purpose: Frozen metric definitions for Capability City. Definitions are fixed before construction so that a metric cannot be redefined after seeing its value.
discipline: Every metric binds to a command, a commit and a machine.
BEFORE and AFTER must use the SAME instrument; if the instrument changes, both instruments are reported.
Absolute counts are always reported alongside ratios, so growth cannot read as improvement.
Negative and absent results are retained verbatim.

legacyManifestGate.scans: only files named in each manifest's `modules:` array; drops edges whose target is undeclared
legacyManifestGate.role: COMPARISON ARM for RQ5. Deliberately retained unmodified (RESEARCH_LEDGER D-001). Its known blindness is part of the experiment, not a bug to fix.

realSourceObservatory.scans: electron/**, src/**, scripts/**, relevant config/plugin manifests
realSourceObservatory.mustNotDependOn: a manifest already declaring the file
realSourceObservatory.rule: Real source is truth. Manifest is annotation. Never the reverse.

metrics.name: files_scanned
metrics.definition: count of production source files the instrument reads

metrics.name: owned_source_files
metrics.definition: count of source files owned by a declared capability

metrics.name: declared_edges
metrics.definition: dependency edges in the declared boot-contract graph

metrics.name: measured_edges
metrics.definition: real file-level cross-capability import edges

metrics.name: kernel_to_feature_edges
metrics.definition: edges where a KERNEL-owned file imports a feature implementation (excluding declared boot adapters/composition root)

metrics.name: lateral_bearing_edges
metrics.definition: capability→capability implementation edges that are not via infrastructure/event bus
metrics.baseline: PENDING (187 total edges, lateral subset to be classified in Phase 0)

metrics.name: structural_cycles
metrics.definition: cycles in the real implementation graph; also largest SCC size

metrics.name: cross_domain_state_accesses
metrics.definition: places a module reads/writes another domain's private state

metrics.name: unclassified_production_files
metrics.definition: production files that resolve to no ownership class
metrics.note: Must be reported, never silently ignored.

metrics.name: capabilities_classified
metrics.definition: count by class: KERNEL | INFRASTRUCTURE | CAPABILITY | COMPOUND | BUNDLE | BRIDGE | UI | BOOTSTRAP | TRUST_DOMAIN | UNCLASSIFIED

metrics.name: removeable_capabilities
metrics.definition: non-kernel capabilities with a passing removal test (boots, unrelated capability works, missing surface reports NOT_INSTALLED/DEGRADED)

metrics.name: replaceable_capabilities
metrics.definition: capabilities with a real replacement path, classified HOT / RESTART / OFFLINE / NON_REPLACEABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION

metrics.name: consumer_edits_during_replacement
metrics.definition: number of consumer files that had to change to replace one implementation

metrics.name: boot_survival_under_removal
metrics.definition: fraction of seeded removals after which Boss Core still boots and unrelated capabilities remain functional

metrics.name: fault_isolation_score
metrics.definition: per fault injection (remove capability / kill provider / corrupt state / disable permission / break bridge / fail replacement): Core survived, unrelated survived, correct degraded state, no fake success, recovery path exists

metrics.name: architecture_violations_detected
metrics.definition: per detector (legacy manifest gate vs real-source observatory) against a seeded ground-truth violation set: true positives, FALSE NEGATIVES, false positives
metrics.baseline: legacy detector M-05 blind: reports violations: [] with 43 kernel→feature edges present

metrics.name: repair_cost
metrics.definition: for a repair: { files_touched, dependency_edges_introduced, permissions_added, state_namespaces_added, test_scope, cleanup_steps, runtime_overhead, architecture_debt_delta }

metrics.name: surface_debt
metrics.definition: counts of { missing_surface, excess_surface, legacy_shim, temporary_bridge, orphan_provider, dead_slot, partial_migration }

metrics.name: topology_debt
metrics.definition: counts of { lateral_dependencies, cycles, cross_state_access, kernel_feature_edges, hidden_coupling, bridge_overstay }

metrics.name: expired_bridges
metrics.definition: migration bridges past their declared removalCondition / expiry milestone

metrics.name: startup_time_ms
metrics.definition: application startup duration

metrics.name: test_time
metrics.definition: wall time per tier (unit / postbuild / slow)
metrics.note: baseline test counts above; timings to be captured in Phase 0

metrics.name: build_time
metrics.definition: wall time for pnpm run build

metrics.name: registry_overhead
metrics.definition: cost of capability registry lookup/routing if introduced
metrics.note: Expected to be non-zero after Phase 1; must be reported as a cost, not hidden.

metrics.name: total_code_size
metrics.definition: production source file count and line count
metrics.note: CONFOUNDER: the city architecture may INCREASE this while reducing coupling. Must be reported alongside every coupling improvement.

topologyHealthSeparation.rule: Report `topology cleanliness` and `surface health` as SEPARATE measures. Never merge them into one score.
topologyHealthSeparation.permittedCombination: surface = FLAT and topology = DIRTY is a valid, reportable state.

rules: Negative results are retained verbatim and never deleted.
A failed experiment stays in the dataset.
Selective omission of regressions is prohibited.
Synthetic results must never be described as production results.
